contextFlags.hasClaims: The page includes quotations, endorsements or factual promotional claims.
contextFlags.hasCollection: The page has a collection that can be searched, filtered or browsed.
contextFlags.hasInteractiveTask: The interface includes an action beyond reading and ordinary links.
contextFlags.hasForm: The interface accepts user input in a form.
contextFlags.hasRemoteRequest: An action depends on a remote operation.
contextFlags.hasDataMutation: An action changes stored or external state.
contextFlags.hasDraft: The task includes editable work that may outlive one screen.
contextFlags.hasConcurrentEditing: More than one context can edit the same work.
contextFlags.hasSupplementalHelp: A control has supplemental help beyond its visible label.
contextFlags.hasTables: The page contains a tabular comparison.
contextFlags.hasReordering: The task includes changing item order.
contextFlags.hasAuthentication: The task uses an authenticated account.
contextFlags.hasMotion: The design uses optional animation or transitions.
contextFlags.hasMultipleLocales: More than one locale is promised.
contextFlags.hasRtlLocale: A promised locale uses right-to-left layout.
contextFlags.hasPrintOutput: Printed or static shared output is in scope.
contextFlags.hasExistingProject: The deliverable changes an existing customer project.
contextFlags.hasCollaboration: Other people are granted project access.
contextFlags.hasRemoteFetch: A service fetches a user-selected remote URL.
contextFlags.hasImportedContent: The workflow reads uploaded or remote material.
contextFlags.hasExport: The workflow produces a downloadable or transferred package.
contextFlags.hasIterationHistory: The product retains design attempt history.
contextFlags.claimsNorthStarEquivalence: The owner intends to make a comparative human-quality claim.
contextFlags.hasControls: The page contains ordinary links, native controls or task actions.

F01.limit: Existing general workshop entry; no direct focused deep link and no new atomic font control are claimed.

D05.limit: Existing bounded palette group; does not implement every proposed semantic-color decision.

G01.limit: Garden preference does not by itself change the Studio integration mode.

G08.limit: Existing Garden lesson preference; does not hide critical warnings.

checks: Complete the inline task using ordinary document navigation; Tab can leave the form without modal containment, and no modal semantics are applied.
Open the modal by keyboard; focus enters logically and remains inside while open, Escape or the close action dismisses it, and focus returns to a valid initiating context.

For ordinary vertically scrolling content, inspect320CSSpixels and400%zoom from1280; required content and functions reflow without two-dimensional page scrolling. Do not require a table choice for a tableless page.
Identify the specific content requiring two-dimensional layout and justify the applicable exception; keep the surrounding page reflowing and exercise the region with keyboard and zoom.

For current Focus guides, test60000/60001UTF-16code units and Target59000/59001preflight values, plus a multibyte fixture proving these are not UTF-8byte limits. Verify complete recovery without clipping.
A future split protocol must declare its size unit, part order and integrity contract. No current support is claimed. Test missing, reordered, duplicate and altered parts before enabling it.

Current Focus records only the current owner's acknowledgment for unchanged work/account/request lifetime. Cancel, supersede and repeat it; stale callbacks receive no saved-work credit. It does not establish a colleague's receipt.

A future colleague delivery channel must bind recipient identity, artifact revision and receipt event. Test wrong recipient, changed artifact, delivery failure and acknowledgment replay; delivery remains distinct from successful use.

Trace every promised release requirement to current scoped evidence. A comparative human-quality claim additionally requires its declared study evidence; an ordinary scoped release does not require that claim or study.
Label the artifact as a draft and list open checks, unsupported operations and safe next actions. Do not require release approval or human-comparison evidence merely to deliver a reviewable draft.
Before an authorized release, match the exact reviewed artifact, audience and deployment target. Existing-project releases additionally need the applicable original-task and rollback evidence.
Label the package as a review draft, disclose open checks and unresolved destinations, and describe how the recipient can inspect it without deployment. No release approval is inferred.
